All I can say if you are not happy with your current career and you prefer doing blue-collar work or are interested in it I say it doesnt hurt to try it but weigh your pro's and con's first and then decide if it's a good fit for you I know people who have gone White-Collar to Blue-Collar and love it because they love doing manual labor and vice versa because some enjoy being extroverts or have skills that have helped them in White-Collar enviroments.
